title: Why face scanning is going to dominate the future of smartphones and laptops (AAPL, MSFT, GOOG)
text: Why face scanning is going to dominate the future of smartphones and laptops (AAPL, MSFT, GOOG) By Edoardo Maggio Feb 14, 2018, 4:45 am 25 pts The introduction of fingerprint scanners in the iPhone popularised secure biometric systems in consumer electronics. But as technology has evolved, the industry has started to call for face scanners instead as they are smarter, more convenient and also more secure. Some high-end devices, like those…
